author: Unreal Engine
description:
This session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 provides an in-depth walkthrough of Unreal Build Accelerator (UBA), how it works with Horde—and how we use them together at Epic Games. 

UBA distributes heavy compilation tasks across local or remote machines to speed up builds. 

We go deeper on UBA, how we have it set up internally at Epic for our build farm, and how Horde and UBA provide access to a massive fleet of helpers for developers in office and working from home. 

The talk also explores what’s new in UBA since Epic first talked about it at Unreal Fest Seattle in 2024.

Find out more about Unreal Build Accelerator here: dev.epicgames.com/documentation/unreal-engine/horde-unreal-build-accelerator-and-remote-compilation-tutorial-for-unreal-engine

title: A Deep Dive into Unreal Build Accelerator | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026

author: Unreal Engine
description:
What does it take to run a single Unreal Engine 5 foundation across multiple in-vehicle and web surfaces across automotive programs? 

Recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026, this session by RV Tech (the joint venture between Rivian and Volkswagen Group) breaks down the architecture, tradeoffs, and hard-won lessons behind making it work at automotive scale. 

RV Tech is building a foundation for scalable, high-fidelity 3D visualization, enabling consistent and engaging experiences across web configurators, in-vehicle software, and diverse interactive experiences for multiple OEMs. 

The talk focuses on practical patterns: how RV Tech defines a common UI and data contract across programs, how they scale content variants without exploding complexity, and how they keep teams aligned as they ship new vehicles and experiences. 

Watch to see how a “one engine, many surfaces” strategy enables an automotive JV to evolve quickly without sacrificing stability, while avoiding program-specific for
title: One Engine, Many Surfaces: Scaling Rivian’s In-Vehicle & Web Experiences | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026
